name: Bloodmage: Eternal Curse multiplies armor from armor items by five (#9509)
contract: Eternal Curse (800157) applies Eternal Curse Hidden (804320), whose effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_BASE_RESISTANCE_PCT on armor with BasePoints 399 + DieSides 1 = 400. Tooltip: "your armor contribution from items is increased by 400%". Armor items (cloth to plate, shields) add base armor, which that aura scales; Agility armor, bonus armor and non-armor items are added afterwards and stay unscaled, so total armor rises by less than 400%. Swapping a stat-free 65-armor chest (Layered Tunic 60) for a stat-free 260-armor chest (Shadowrend Leather Vest 399205) must therefore raise armor five times as much inside the form as outside it, independent of the starting outfit and Agility.

steps.label: Eternal Curse Hidden effect 0 resolves to 400
